text:
Lena (Product): Quick sync on the Private/VPC stepper. Goals: make each networking step scannable, tighten copy for CIDR/egress IPs, add non-blocking validation, and fix the a11y announcements. Thoughts?
Michael (Design): Love keeping validations non-blocking. UX requests: 1) show a tiny status chip next to each step (idle/pending/ok/fail) instead of a big modal; 2) change label 'External IP' to 'Egress IP(s) (optional)' when publicAccess=false; 3) add a short inline rationale under each required field.
Srini (Eng): Agree on chips. Implementation notes: we'll return a preflight_handle from the API so the UI can poll /preflight/:id. Tests should be cancellable and rate-limited. Also call out that some customers will paste multiple CIDRs; we should accept comma, space, or newline separated values and normalize on submit.
Jia (DevEx): Accessibility checklist: - inputs need aria-describedby linking to helper text that includes examples. - validation status must update an aria-live region. - stepper should be keyboard navigable with aria-current on the active step. - color contrast: current yellow alert is 3.2:1; swap to #b36b00 or use an alert outline to meet 4.5:1.
Priya (QA): Small QA point: when a preflight fails due to DNS, make the failure message specific ("DNS lookup failed for private.redwood.example") and include a copyable troubleshooting command. Avoid generic "connectivity failed". Also add an e2e test for the skip-and-validate flow.
Lena (Product): Copy suggestions: helper for CIDR -> "CIDR ranges (e.g. 10.0.0.0/16). You can enter several ranges separated by commas or newlines." For egress IPs -> "Public egress IP(s) used for outbound requests. Enter one or more addresses." Also change the CTA on the step to "Validate network" rather than "Test".
Michael (Design): Regarding ports: show a compact table with columns: port | direction | purpose. Example row: "443 | outbound | health checks & TLS". Keep rows collapsible so advanced users can expand for protocol/ICMP notes.
Srini (Eng): Add copyable test snippets in the UI. Example: 
````
# curl health check from customer network
curl -sfS https://private.redwood.example/health || echo "health check failed"
# tcp check
nc -vz private.redwood.example 443
````
These should be one-click copy.
Jia (DevEx): Docs: add anchors for each step and link the "why this matters" to them. Also include a sample Terraform VPC module snippet in docs for the 3 common topologies we see.
Priya (QA): Keyboard flow: if user chooses "Skip and validate later", focus should move to the next step header and a small inline banner should appear with the message: "Preflight required before finalizing deployment". Make sure screen readers announce that banner.
Lena (Product): Good. Decision: make "Skip and validate later" secondary, require explicit keyboard confirmation if they skip all checks, and show the preflight chip with a red outline until validation passes.
ci-bot: preview-deploy: Figma/PR preview is available at https://staging.redwood.io/preview/stepper/1861023456 and nightly preview runs.
Michael (Design): I'll push a small Figma update with the chips, port table, and the new helper copy. Tagging @Jia for the aria-live region placement.
Lena (Product): Thanks everyone. I'll update the spec doc and include the exact microcopy and the acceptance criteria for QA. Ping me when the backend preflight_id is ready. :rocket:
